issue20_acceptance.body:
Parent #1; new ecosystem task; Phase 0; developer-experience owner. Depends on URB-010 (#3) and URB-020 (#4). Does not delay the first harness increment.

## Findings
Community repositories `ryanthomas-org/urbit-skills` and `thelifeandtimes/running-urbit` exist. The latter is MIT and distinguishes `validated: safe` (no obvious injection found) from `works` (manually exercised). The sampled Gall skill's minimal save/load examples do not consistently use the same versioned payload. Do not equate its safety annotation with compiler-correct code.

## Acceptance
- Use concise repo-local Hoon/Gall/testing/release SKILL.md files and scoped AGENTS guidance. Do not globally install a large skill pack or grant live conn.sock access.
- Pin candidate upstream sources, review actual license and instructions, restrict imported material to useful reviewed subsets, and retain notices if copied. Record unsafe/outdated examples and propose upstream fixes separately.
- Evaluate optional `urbit/hoon-language-server` against the pinned fake-ship stack; editors are aids, compiler/tests remain authoritative. No production +code in command lines or config.
- Run a frozen skill evaluation: compile a typed function, repair a type error, implement matching save/load migration, reject unauthorized poke/watch, detect a missing test, build a desk. Record baseline vs assisted results per model/toolchain; no improvement claim without runs.

## Tests
Skill frontmatter/link checks; actual compile/runtime evaluation and sandbox negative controls; LF source enforcement; clean contributor setup. Standard location reference: https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/build-skills . Pinned review candidate: https://github.com/thelifeandtimes/running-urbit/tree/90912c1425573de37110a65627c6ab4bf125586c .
